$comment: Reference definition for the call-ending tool. Vapi's UI is where this is actually configured; this file keeps the intended configuration version-controlled. VERIFY field names against current Vapi docs before relying on this.

function.name: end_intake_call
function.description: End the call without transferring. Used only on the paths where a transfer is wrong or impossible.

$calledFrom: G0 - caller declines the intake at the greeting
N16 - early exit, or caller declines the transfer
GI-1 - medical emergency, after directing the caller to call 911
GI-2 - voicemail or automated message detected, intake never runs
$neverCalledFrom: N15 completion - a completed intake always ends in transfer_to_licensed_agent, never here
GI-4 - an explicit request for a human is a transfer, not a hangup
